_comment: When a mute hides the unfinished-software warning (docs/design/app-bottom-strip.md, section 3.5). Read by BOTH apps' tests, so the desktop rule (src/gui/bottom_strip/mute.rs `muted`) and the website's (web/shared/shell.js `hosWipMuted`) are held to one list. `mute` is the record as kept (config.json `wip_mute` on the desktop, `hos_wip_mute` in the browser): `until` in seconds since 1970, absent for a mute of this session only, and `version`, the version it was muted on. A mute holds only on its own version and only before its time; anything unreadable shows the warning. `now` is seconds since 1970. The title screen and the warning's own page are not cases here: they show the bar whatever the mute (each app's own test).

cases.why: this session, but a new version started
one day, the second before it ends
one week, but a new version started
the same number written another way is another version
an until that is not a number: unreadable
a record that is not an object
a list is not a record either
